subQuests.subQuestName: Shoot at the Prototype Kresnik's Torch

771010501.text: The door at the back of the royal hall appears to be shut...

771010503.text: Please wait a moment. I sense that there may be a port in front of the throne I can connect to...

771010506.text: I have gained access to the mechanism.

771010507.text: ...Alright. The way to unlock the door here is more or less the same as the main entrance.

771010508.text: "Let the two-headed beast, guardian of that most majestic corse, return unto its rightful place."

771010509.text: "The two-headed beast"...? Are we talking about that statue back at the entrance...?

771010510.text: Paimon seems to hear a door opening over there...

771010511.text: Oh, look inside that room. There's another statue that looks just like the one at the entrance.

771010512.text: "Return unto its rightful place," huh? Oh, Paimon gets it now! We'll have to move both statues onto this mechanism right here, don't we?

771010513.text: It certainly appears to be the case, Paimon.

subQuests.subQuestName: Find a way to open the door to the royal hall
Talk to the Eye of Graeae

771010701.text: (...Huh? What's going on? Isn't this... Am I...?)

771010702.text: (Ah. Just like how I was at the Alypium earlier... This place is also in the past...)

771010703.text: Your Majesty, I am pleased to report that the first experiment have been completed.

771010704.text: The great hypothesis is about to be proven right. With continued cultivation, we shall soon witness the birth of a complete prototype of the Primordial Human.

771010705.text: The first experiments have been completed, you say?

771010706.text: Yes, Your Majesty. We found that the test subjects entered a realm of boundless joy... where they'd never suffer sorrow or distress again...

771010707.text: And they never woke up again.

771010708.text: No, they never did wake up again. But that is entirely logical, given that the realm they entered was no mere dream. Your Majesty... we are speaking of a butterfly breaking free from its cocoon, or a bird bursting from its shell.

771010709.text: And by breaking free, they have left all the pain and sorrow arising from desires and fixations behind like a useless cocoon... All that remains is a broken dream, a pain as blurry and indistinct as a shadow.

771010710.text: That new courtyard, Aksinya. Is that the world of your dreams? The one you seek to reach?

771010712.text: Your will is my will, Your Majesty.

771010713.text: ...Is that so? When then, will you embark on the final part of the plan?

771010714.text: I shall require more time before I can do that. However, I expect everything to be ready... by the time Your Majesty returns victorious from the front.

771010715.text: I am certain that Your Majesty will return victorious.

771010716.text: ... Yes, I shall, Aksinya. And you may rest easy, for Zver shall accompany me. It will never abandon me, no matter what.

771010719.text: In that case, I shall stay here to wait for you... Your Majesty.

771010720.text: I shall remain here until Your Majesty's wish has been fulfilled, until your will has been done...

771010721.text: #What is it, {NICKNAME}? You're doing it again — just standing there, staring blankly like a dummy...

771010723.text: I saw something from the past...

771010724.text: Hmm... Then did you see anything that made you uncomfortable or something?

771010726.text: Alright! In that case... The door to the palace's royal hall is already open! Come on, let's keep moving!

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to the Eye of Graeae

771010601.text: Great, the door's open... Oof. Those were some strange-looking monsters back there...

771010602.text: They are man-made monsters... created by Koshchei at the Alypium back in the day.

771010603.text: Then... what about the creature that was just talking? Paimon thought we'd have seen it by now...

771010604.text: That's... Zver, or "The Beast." It's one of many of Koshchei's bio-alchemical creations, and the leader of the man-made monsters.

771010605.text: Back then, Koshchei created a number of "prototypes" using the same materials... But of these prototypes, the only ones that turned out to have a shred of intelligence were Zver and... Hmm. This is strange. I don't seem to be able to recall now.

771010606.text: Koshchei deemed Zver nothing more than a half-formed creation, so he chose to abandon it.

771010607.text: In the end, that unfinished form was fused with the seeds of other monsters, molding it into its present shape. Truly, it should have been destroyed back then.

771010608.text: But before it could be unmade, the Belyi Tsar, believing that no being with sentience should be so discarded, decided to take the creature into his service.

771010609.text: ...It was said that it was Zver who had dragged the Belyi Tsar's body back from the battlefield, even though it was itself gravely injured at the time.

771010610.text: That is the reason it loathed Koshchei so...

771010611.text: I thought it had already perished somewhere, quietly and unnoticed. But no, this is excellent news.

771010612.text: Never did I imagine that it would be standing watch over the Belyi Tsar's body all this time — in this minor palace that is now effectively a mausoleum.

771010613.text: Whoa, Paimon finally gets why nobody is supposed to come here without asking first! Maybe everyone who sneaked in without permission got totally scared off by that beast!

771010614.text: It's too dangerous to venture further to Pale Crown Palace. Zver...

771010615.text: That's alright. We're already here anyway. We'll definitely get you your body back.

771010616.text: If it comes around again, we'll just fight it off.

771010617.text: #Alright, I believe you, {NICKNAME}... and you too, Paimon...

771010618.text: We'll have to stay alert from now on. That creature is likely to appear again...

771010619.text: Please leave this matter to me.

771010801.text: Hmm... Paimon doesn't know why, but the higher we get, the more anxious Paimon gets...

771010802.text: Are you feeling that way because of the "Beast"?

771010803.text: Mmhmm. Hey, that creature knows how to talk, doesn't it? Maybe we can reason with it... and it won't see us as intruders barging in anymore...

771010804.text: "As long as we communicate, we can reach an understanding..." Perhaps it truly is as Miss Paimon says.

771010806.text: #...Something isn't quite right, {NICKNAME}. I've detected a high-energy object... And it's approaching us! LOOK OUT, {NICKNAME}!

771010807.text: I have warned you people time and time again. And yet, you continue to seek inevitable destruction...

subQuests.subQuestName: Find a way to melt the solid ice before you
Find a way to open the gates

771011401.text: Um.. AHEM! You miserable cur! I know you're in there! I know you're hiding inside that tiny little mechanism like the coward you are...

771011402.text: ...Hah! I thought you were long dead! Come out, then! Come out and show yourself!

771011403.text: ...It seems we were both mistaken, then.

771011404.text: Is that what you've turned into? How pathetic!

771011405.text: A pity I won't get to see that face of yours again. It's worth far more to me than the rest of your existence.

771011406.text: #...Is this the new {M#master}{F#mistress} you have chosen? Or is {M#he}{F#she} simply just another meticulously chosen sacrifice of yours?

771011407.text: Hahahahaha! Oh blond-haired human, do you really know what you are doing?

771011410.text: ...Ha. Hard to believe that a person as powerful and yet pure of heart as you actually exists in this world... But I must warn you: that companion of yours inside that mechanism? They might not be as trustworthy as you think.

771011411.text: You can take your nonsense and shove it, you two-headed freak! We're traveling with Goggles here...

771011412.text: And we've already become friends. Don't you dare speak ill of him!

771011413.text: Ahahaha, "Goggles"? Fine then, "Goggles," would you like to tell your new friends over here about your friends from before?

771011416.text: So you really have no inkling... Ha! That woman was pushed into the Shadow Realm, while your body was split up into three. That is why you don't have all your powers now...

771011417.text: AHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA.... Ahem... Heh heh heh. You don't remember a thing because you don't have all your powers. I cannot believe this... This is beyond absurd.

771011418.text: The grand power of fate... like a spinning thread, it allows no escape. You may have lost all your memories, and yet you have returned and now stand here...

771011419.text: Before that wretched and broken body of yours...

771011420.text: Zver. All I want is to retrieve what is mine.

771011421.text: Ahem... What are you talking about? Nothing you held was ever truly yours. Everything you ever "had" came from His Majesty!

771011422.text: Our flesh, our blood, the very seed of consciousness that was rooted into the core of our beings... They were all given to us by him!

771011423.text: I see. So I am... a prototype. Just like you.

771011424.text: ...Except that I was the failed specimen, and you eventually became the vessel for the Key. But you should have never remained in existence. Your consciousness should have been erased long ago.

771011426.text: His body, that is. The only things in existence that are meaningful are his body, his flesh and blood. Because he was the perfect creation grown in His Majesty's likeness.

771011427.text: The only other thing worth anything at all would be his face... It looked exactly like the Tsar in a painting of him as a child.

771011428.text: Hmph, but if I were to see that face again, I would tear it with my teeth and swallow it whole.

771011429.text: Why would you do that??? You and I, we are clearly the same...

771011430.text: Bah! You and I, we are not the same! I am the Beast in the service of the Belyi Tsar. "Zver" was the name His Majesty bestowed upon me.

771011431.text: I was the one who received his acknowledgement and praise. I was the one to whom he promised glory everlasting. Though I had a useless, hopelessly ill-shapen form... He ensured that my existence did not go to waste.

771011432.text: I was the one who followed His Majesty to every battlefield, the one who resisted the dark tide of the Abyss alongside the monsters and fae... And I was the one who brought his lifeless body back from that pitch-black ruin.

771011433.text: Maybe I should have, right there and then... O Your Majesty, I have watched over your long-sleeping body for five centuries now. I believe it is finally time... finally time for me to follow in your footsteps.

771011434.text: I have, right up to the very end... fulfilled my vow. Even the very final moment of my life shall be for your sake... Aaaah...

771011435.text: And you? Ha! You pitiable fool. You have become the most pathetic of us all...

771011436.text: We may share the same flesh and blood...\nBut you, "Proto-Man," don't even have a name to call your own...

771011437.text: And with that, the beast with two heads falls limp.\nThe sheer will — rather than bodily strength — that has held it up all this time... drains away.\nIn an instant, its form dissipates like fine sand into the wind, as a faint cry fades into the dust.

771011438.text: (Here comes that feeling again... Is this another memory from the "past"!?)

771011439.text: (Yes, I'm seeing... Zver from the past now...)

771011440.text: Your Majesty, you wished to see me... How may I serve you?

771011441.text: Or is this regarding... that incident involving the human noble the other day? The one where I executed without authorization? I beg you to...

771011442.text: Dispense with the terror. I have no intention to strike you down.

771011443.text: The details of the matter are already known to me — Aksinya and Koshchei have given their report. The eldest son of the House Solovyov chanced upon something he shouldn't have... And the fault clearly lies with the two of them.

771011444.text: Your actions have spared Koshchei and the others a rather significant headache.

771011445.text: Me? But helping him was the furthest thing from my mind! I only acted to... ensure that Your Majesty's private affairs remained entirely inviolable.

771011446.text: And yet, you owe your very existence to him, Zver. Perhaps he alone deserves the title of your father.

771011447.text: That is indeed true, Your Majesty. It was he who gave an imperfect creature such as I a tongue with which to speak.

771011448.text: Yet, that has not stopped him from looking upon me... as a flawed creation that should have been destroyed from the very beginning. Your Majesty...

771011449.text: Must a creation forever bend the knee to its creator? Surely, even an imperfect being like myself cannot be expected to endure the neglect, the contempt, and the unending wrath of the one who fashioned me?

771011450.text: Must the thing created... always walk the path its maker has laid out, and bow to his every caprice?

771011452.text: Ah, I wasn't speaking of y——

771011453.text: None of that bears weight here, Zver. None of it. There are times when the sole matter of consequence is the path one resolves to take.

771011454.text: And once that path is taken, one never looks back... for that alone is the matter of consequence.

771011455.text: Your Majesty. I fear I have misspoken, and for that, I extend my deepest apologies...

771011456.text: Think no more of it. I, too, have now bound myself to a chosen path, and shall know the touch of doubt no longer...

771011457.text: Oh, Zver, my forgiveness is yours... Though you may hold no need for such grace to begin with, I forgive you for not following the orders of your creator.

771011458.text: Your Majesty, I accept your forgiveness, but solely for the sake of the one who offers it.

771011459.text: I accept your forgiveness, solely because I have chosen to shoulder the burden of your expectations, and because I am fully aware that my life belongs to you, and that I shall one day surrender it to you.

771011460.text: Though no one exacted this deed from me, I hope when the moment comes, you will remember that this choice, too, was entirely my own.

771011461.text: Indeed, Zver, my adorable friend... I shall never forget what you have told me today.

771011462.text: Emotional fluctuation detected. It is of the same kind as before...

771011464.text: Are you seeing strange things again?

771011465.text: #The closer we get to the upper levels of Pale Crown Palace, the greater the effect this place has on {NICKNAME}...

771011466.text: #And {NICKNAME}'s perception capabilities... are clearly keener than most.

771011467.text: #But thankfully, it does not look like this will have any ill effects on {M#him}{F#her}.

771011471.text: Hmm, I saw someone talking to that "Beast"...

771011473.text: What is it, Goggles? Did you just remember something?

771011474.text: I suspect it was the Belyi Tsar who spoke with Zver... Although it's been 500 years... he might have left something behind here...

771011475.text: However, his motives in doing so remain entirely unclear to me. I fear... the only way I can remember is to recover all my powers.

771011477.text: ...So, Goggles, "Eye of Graeae" isn't your name then?

771011478.text: ...Perhaps. Perhaps it's just the name of this device, and I simply assumed...

771011480.text: Never mind about that! That Zver freak was probably just spouting total nonsense anyway! Maybe you'll actually know your real name once you get all your powers back!

771011482.text: But... what should we call you in the meantime then?

771011483.text: Since my consciousness is now housed inside this mechanism... either the "Eye of Graeae" or "Goggles" would do fine.

771011484.text: Alright then, Goggles! Let's start looking for your missing parts right now! They must be somewhere around here, right?

subQuests.subQuestName: Obtain the part of the Eye of Graeae's body
Talk to the Eye of Graeae

771011701.text: Ooh, look. This is a piece of Goggles, and someone's left a note next to it.

771011702.text: "Alvis has paid the price for his crime of defiling the sacred form, and the flesh and blood taken by the covetous Domovoy have been recovered from Novokitezhgrad..."

771011703.text: Hold on, hold on — so, does that mean that this piece of Goggles' body wasn't here all this time?

771011704.text: Analysis of this handwriting indicates that the author is Aksinya.

771011705.text: Novokitezhgrad is of course a rather long way away from here... That might explain why I have never been able to sense or detect this piece of my body.

771011706.text: Huh. So she was the one who brought this piece back from, um, Novokitezhgrad. That's... a city southeast of Snezhnograd, Paimon thinks...

771011707.text: Oh that's right, didn't Netochka say that she used to live in Novokitezhgrad...?

771011711.text: Oh, so you mean the Alypium you saw before entering the Pale Crown Palace... the one in the past?

771011712.text: Was "Alvis" one of those people you saw there?

771011713.text: No, I don't think I actually saw him...

771011714.text: Alvis... was the lord of the Domovoy. Though he was indeed a member of the Alypium, unfortunately there is not much more I can recall at the moment.

771011715.text: Well, no matter who he was, judging from that note, things probably didn't end well for him.

771011716.text: Oh, look, there's another line written here on the back. It says... "The final mission is thus: return the flesh and blood of the King, and begin a new era with the Key."

771011719.text: Given that my body is already shattered, I would not be able to reconstruct it even if I have all my powers back. I'll have to... place it somewhere.

771011720.text: Oh, so you mean collecting the pieces and putting them in the same room alone won't do it? We have to bring them someplace, huh...
